subject: general
question:
**Directions: **Answer the question given below

Your female colleague informs you that her boss is deliberately making her stay late at night and making inappropriate moves towards her. What will you do first?

options.text: Make her come forward and inform the senior authority so that they will take action against him.
Ask her to ignore the man, he has a bad reputation.
Make her file a complaint against the man.
Let her take her own decision on the action she wants to take but help her if she needs it.

solution:
From the given options, only option 2 is incorrect. So it is eliminated.

Among the other three, the ***best one*** is to let her decide what action she wants to take against the man since it is a sensitive issue. You must not force her to do anything.

She ***must decide if she wants to inform the senior authority or file an FIR against the man or maybe warn the manager first.*** Then you can accordingly lend her a helping hand if she needs or asks for it.

Hence the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• *In case of sensitive issues such as sexual harassment, whether the woman wants to escalate the issue to the police or wants to get it solved within the official limits is up to her. You can suggest the correct course of action but it would be her choice in the end.*
